IF 7: Pipeline
B082 cbc:Mode Code M 1 n1 Specify Inward Transport Mode. THEN B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).

IF B076 cbc:Conveyance Reference Number C 1 an..17 For transport mode = 1, specify inward voyage number. THEN B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).

IF Specify ‘NA’
if there is no inward voyage number. THEN B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).
IF For transport mode = 4, specify inward flight number. THEN B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).

IF Specify ‘NA’
if there is no inward flight number. THEN B078 cbc:Net Register Tonnage C 1 n..15 Specify the Net Register Ton of outward vessel (TNE).

IF exception applies (a) For all Declaration Types, specify inward transport, except
for the following:
i) goods released from licensed premises such as Licensed
Warehouse, Excise Factory, Zero-GST Warehouse, Bonded
Warehouse
ii) declaration type = BKT (Blanket)
iii) declaration type = SHO
iv) for goods previously exempted/suspended from duties/taxes
v) supplementary declaration for schemes under AISS, IGDS
such as place of receipt = AISSLOC, SPIGDS
b) For Declaration Type = SFZ (when there is intergateway
movement):
i) Specify Inward transport.) THEN route to manual review
IF exception applies (B055 cbc:Discharge Port C 1 an..5 Specify Port of Discharge except for seastore permits application.) THEN route to manual review

IF exception applies (B016 cbc:Final Destination Country C 1 a2 Specify Country of Final Destination for outward transport for
declaration type = REX and SFZ(with inter-gateway movement without
storage) except for seastore permits application.) THEN route to manual review
